description: Nine commands to test isolation: user identity, directory listing, restricted file access, read-only filesystem, and workspace verification.

steps.description: All nine verification commands to run inside the container.
User identity: id command shows non-root user.
Home directory: ls /home shows minimal contents, cat /etc/shadow is permission denied.
Read-only filesystem: touch /etc/x fails with Read-only file system error.
Isolation: find cannot locate decoy-secret.txt outside the mounted workspace.
Workspace access: cat README.txt works, writing to /workspace/from-container.txt succeeds.
Agent: omp --version checks the agent is available, exit leaves the container.
